Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.
Matter is taken up in the revised call.

By means of the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
424 of 2023 at Police Station- Raunapar, District- Azamgarh under Sections 376, 377, 506 IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 03.01.2024.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 13.03.2024.

The following arguments made by Sri Babhru Vahan Singh, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Sri Rishi Chadha, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
Parth Sarthi Gargvanshi vs State Of U.P. on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138669032/

sentences.text: 1. Delay in lodgement of the FIR in the facts of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
2. The victim is a married lady who was estranged with her husband.
3. The applicant and the victim became intimate over the years and developed consensual physical relations.
4. The FIR is the result of the said relationship getting exposed.
5. The applicant has been falsely nominated by the victim only to deflect attention from her own conduct and to save her marriage.
6. The victim in her statement under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. has admitted to intimacy with the applicant.

The victim in the latter part of the said statement and latter part of the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. false and aggravated allegations were made by the victim at the behest of her parents to save the failing prosecution case and deflect attention from her conduct.

7. The victim has not made any allegation of commission of rape, abduction or forceful assault against the applicant in her statement under Sections 161 CrPC and 164 CrPC.
8.
The applicant never captured any indecent video or photograph of the victim.
No such video or photograph has been recovered from the applicant during the investigations.
9. The victim was never confined or bound down in any manner.
The victim was present at various public places but never raised an alarm nor did she resist the applicant.
The conduct of the victim shows that she was a consenting party.

10. Major inconsistencies in the statements of the victim under Sections 161 Cr.P.C.
and Section 164 Cr.P.C. as well as the recitals in the F.I.R. discredit the prosecution case.
11. Medical evidence to establish the commission of rape by the applicant with the victim has not been produced by the prosecution.
12. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
13. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.

Parth Sarthi Gargvanshi vs State Of U.P. on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138669032/

sentences.text: In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Parth Sarthi Gargvanshi be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number,
on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
( ii )
The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(iii) The learned trial court is directed to fix the sureties after due application of mind in light of the judgement passed by this Court in Arvind Singh v. State of U.P. Thru.
Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. (Application U/S 482 No.2613 of 2023).
The learned trial court shall ensure that the right of bail of the applicant granted by this Court is not frustrated by arbitrary demands of sureties or onerous conditions which are unrelated to the socioeconomic status of the applicant.
Order Date :- 15.5.2024
